title: 飯店住宿
description: 飯店入住與退房相關用語

sentences.en: Good evening, I have a reservation under the name Johnson for a deluxe room with a king-sized bed, which I booked through your website about three weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 晚安，我有一筆以乘Johnson為名的訂房，是大約三週前透過你們的網站預訂的豪華大床房。

sentences.en: I was wondering if it would be possible to get an early check-in, since my flight arrived much earlier than expected and I am quite exhausted from the overnight journey.
sentences.zh: 我想問一下能否提早入住，因為我的班機比預期早到很多，而且坐了一夜的飛機相當疲憊。

sentences.en: The air conditioning unit in my room appears to be malfunctioning, as it has been making a loud rattling noise all night and the temperature does not seem to be dropping at all.
sentences.zh: 我房間的冷氣機似乎故障了，整晚都發出很大的嘎嘎聲，而且溫度似乎完全沒有下降。

sentences.en: Could you please send someone from housekeeping to bring extra towels and replace the shampoo bottles, which appear to have been left empty by the previous guest?
sentences.zh: 能否請你派房務人員送額外的毛巾並更換洗髮精瓶？那些似乎是上一位房客用完留下的空瓶。

sentences.en: I would like to extend my stay for two additional nights, provided that the same room type is available, because my business meetings have been postponed until Friday.
sentences.zh: 如果同類型房間還有空的話，我想延住兩晚，因為我的商務會議延期到星期五了。

sentences.en: The complimentary breakfast buffet, which is served in the restaurant on the second floor from six thirty to ten, includes both Western and Asian cuisine options.
sentences.zh: 免費的早餐自助餐在二樓餐廳供應，時間為六點半到十點，包含西式和亞洲料理選擇。

sentences.en: I noticed an unauthorized charge on my bill for the minibar, but I am certain that I did not consume anything from it during my entire stay at your hotel.
sentences.zh: 我注意到帳單上有一筆未經授權的迷你吧費用，但我確定在整個住宿期間我沒有使用過迷你吧的任何東西。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to request a room change to a higher floor, preferably one with a city view, as the street noise on the second floor kept me awake most of last night?
sentences.zh: 可以要求換到較高樓層的房間嗎？最好有城市景觀的，因為二樓的街道噪音讓我昨晚大部分時間都無法入睡。

sentences.en: The concierge recommended a highly-rated seafood restaurant within walking distance that apparently requires reservations at least two days in advance during the tourist season.
sentences.zh: 禮賓服務人員推薦了一間步行距離內的高評價海鮮餐廳，據說旅遊旺季時至少需要提前兩天預訂。

sentences.en: I am checking out this morning and would like to settle my bill, but I need a detailed invoice separated by room charges and restaurant expenses for my company's accounting department.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上要退房結帳，但我需要一張將房費和餐飲費分開的明細發票，給我公司的會計部門。

sentences.en: The Wi-Fi connection in my room has been extremely slow and unstable since yesterday, which is causing serious problems because I need reliable internet access for my remote work.
sentences.zh: 我房間的Wi-Fi從昨天開始就非常慢且不穩定，這造成了嚴重問題因為我遠距工作需要穩定的網路。

sentences.en: I left a black leather briefcase in the hotel safe when I checked out last Thursday, and I was calling to arrange a time to pick it up at your earliest convenience.
sentences.zh: 我上週四退房時把一個黑色皮革公事包留在飯店保險箱了，我打電話來安排方便的時間來取。

sentences.en: The hotel shuttle service that runs to the airport every hour on the half hour would be perfect for my departure tomorrow, so could you please reserve me a seat on the six-thirty bus?
sentences.zh: 每小時半點發車前往機場的飯店接駁車對我明天的出發很合適，能否幫我預約六點半那班車的座位？

sentences.en: Since we are celebrating our wedding anniversary this weekend, I was hoping you might be able to arrange something special in the room, such as flowers and a bottle of champagne.
sentences.zh: 因為我們這週末要慶祝結婚紀念日，我希望你們能在房間裡安排一些特別的東西，例如花和一瓶香檳。

sentences.en: The swimming pool on the rooftop, which offers a panoramic view of the entire city skyline, is only accessible to guests staying in the premium suites on the upper floors.
sentences.zh: 頂樓的游泳池可以看到整個城市天際線的全景，但只有住在高樓層豪華套房的旅客才能使用。

sentences.en: I accidentally locked myself out of my room while stepping into the hallway to get ice, and unfortunately I do not have my key card or any identification with me.
sentences.zh: 我出去走廊拿冰塊時不小心把自己鎖在房間外面了，不幸的是身上沒有房卡也沒有任何證件。

sentences.en: The room service menu indicates that orders placed after eleven at night will incur an additional late-night surcharge of fifteen percent on top of the regular prices.
sentences.zh: 客房服務菜單上標示晚上十一點後的訂單會在正常價格之上額外收取百分之十五的深夜附加費。

sentences.en: We specifically booked a family suite with two adjoining rooms so that our children could have their own space while still being close enough for us to check on them.
sentences.zh: 我們特別訂了有兩間相鄰房間的家庭套房，這樣孩子們可以有自己的空間，同時又近到我們可以隨時照看。

sentences.en: The fitness center located in the basement level is equipped with modern cardio machines and free weights, and is open twenty-four hours a day for registered hotel guests.
sentences.zh: 位於地下樓層的健身中心配備現代有氧器材和自由重量器材，全天二十四小時對已登記的飯店房客開放。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could arrange a wake-up call for five forty-five tomorrow morning, because I have an early meeting and I do not entirely trust my phone alarm.
sentences.zh: 如果你能安排明天早上五點四十五分的叫醒服務我會很感激，因為我有個很早的會議而且我不完全信任手機鬧鐘。

sentences.en: The receptionist explained that the security deposit charged upon check-in would be fully refunded to my credit card within three to five business days after checkout.
sentences.zh: 接待人員解釋入住時收取的押金會在退房後三到五個工作天內全額退回我的信用卡。

sentences.en: Due to a pipe burst on the floor above, there is water leaking through the ceiling of my bathroom, and I would appreciate being moved to another room as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 由於樓上的水管爆裂，我浴室的天花板正在漏水，希望能盡快幫我換到另一個房間。

sentences.en: The hotel's loyalty program, which I enrolled in during my last visit, offers members a complimentary room upgrade and late checkout when available during their birthday month.
sentences.zh: 我上次入住時加入的飯店忠誠計畫，在會員生日月份提供免費房間升等和延遲退房（視空房情況）。

sentences.en: I need to store my luggage at the front desk for a few hours after checking out because my flight does not depart until late evening and I want to explore the city.
sentences.zh: 退房後我需要把行李寄放在櫃台幾個小時，因為我的班機要到深夜才起飛，我想去逛逛這座城市。

sentences.en: The spa treatment I booked for this afternoon, which includes a sixty-minute full-body massage and a facial, requires guests to arrive at least fifteen minutes early for preparation.
sentences.zh: 我預約了今天下午的水療療程——包括六十分鐘全身按摩和臉部護理——要求客人至少提早十五分鐘到達做準備。

sentences.en: Could you recommend a reliable laundry service that can clean and press my suit by tomorrow morning, since I have an important presentation and my clothes got wrinkled during the flight?
sentences.zh: 能否推薦一個可靠的洗衣服務，可以在明天早上前把我的西裝洗好燙好？因為我有重要的簡報而且衣服在飛行途中皺了。

sentences.en: The view from our balcony on the twentieth floor is absolutely breathtaking, overlooking the harbor with its colorful boats and the mountains rising dramatically in the background.
sentences.zh: 我們二十樓陽台的景色令人驚嘆，俯瞰港口中色彩繽紛的船隻和背景中壯觀聳立的山脈。

sentences.en: I was informed at check-in that the hotel is fully booked this weekend due to a major convention, which explains why the lobby and restaurant have been unusually crowded.
sentences.zh: 入住時被告知飯店這週末因大型會議而客滿，這解釋了為什麼大廳和餐廳異常擁擠。

sentences.en: The electronic door lock on my room seems to be rejecting my key card no matter which way I insert it, so I would appreciate it if someone could come and take a look.
sentences.zh: 我房間的電子門鎖不管我怎麼插入房卡都無法開啟，希望能派人來看一下。

sentences.en: Before finalizing the reservation, I wanted to confirm whether your cancellation policy allows a full refund if I cancel more than forty-eight hours before the scheduled check-in date.
sentences.zh: 在確認訂房前，我想確認你們的取消政策是否允許在預定入住日期的四十八小時前取消可獲得全額退款。
